title: GraphDecisionBench: Benchmarking System One Models on Graph Tasks
abstract: arXiv:2610.06354v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly explored for graph understanding and decision-making, while System One models such as Jev select directly from supplied options. However, the capabilities of System One models on graph-related tasks remain unclear. We introduce GraphDecide, a model-independent benchmark that combines structural task profiles, matched graph-text input contrasts and heuristic-proposal controls to diagnose graph decision performance. We evaluate Jev and related choice-based models alongside language-model baselines, covering fourteen model-interface configurations. Jev's results illustrate the benchmark's central distinctions: accurate adjacency recognition does not guarantee broader structural correctness, joint graph-text input does not consistently improve prediction, and feasible construction does not establish high solution quality. translated_title: GraphDecisionBench：图任务上系统一模型的基准测试
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）在图理解与决策方面的应用正受到越来越多的探索，而以Jev为代表的系统一（System One）模型则会直接从给定选项中进行选择。然而，系统一模型在图相关任务上的能力仍不明确。我们提出了GraphDecide，一个与模型无关的基准，它结合了结构化任务画像、匹配的图-文本输入对照以及启发式提案控制，用于诊断图决策性能。我们在语言模型基线之外，对Jev及相关基于选择的模型进行了评估，涵盖十四种模型-接口配置。Jev的结果凸显了该基准的核心区分点：准确的邻接识别并不能保证更广泛的结构正确性；图与文本的联合输入并不总能提升预测效果；构造出可行解也不意味着能获得高质量的解。其任务契约、候选接口与评分规则支持可比较的分析（原文在此处截断）。
tldr: 提出与模型无关的图决策基准GraphDecisionBench（GraphDecide），通过结构化任务画像、图-文本输入对照与启发式提案控制，系统评估Jev等系统一模型在图任务上的表现，揭示出邻接识别准确不等于整体结构正确、联合图-文本输入未必提升预测、可行解构造也未必带来高质量解。
en_tdlr: Introduces GraphDecisionBench (GraphDecide), a model-independent graph decision benchmark combining structural task profiles, matched graph-text input contrasts, and heuristic-proposal controls, which systematically evaluates System One models like Jev and reveals that accurate adjacency recognition, joint graph-text inputs, and feasible constructions do not guarantee broader structural correctness, improved predictions, or high solution quality.
